title.fr: Production de signaux non sinusoïdaux (multivibrateurs astables)

sketch:
Observe: astable multivibrator schematic (2 transistors + 2 caps +
4 resistors, or ampli-op astable variant). Student watches the two
collectors alternate — square wave at each output, complementary.
Sliders on R and C set the period T = 2·R·C·ln 2. Experiment: hit
a target frequency by choosing R and C. Also inspect a triangular
wave from a follow-up integrator. Evaluate: given a target waveform
(square, triangular, sawtooth), assemble the correct astable +
shaping stage. Wrinkle: duty cycle asymmetry via mismatched R_1,
R_2.
